The structure of MgCu3Se4 is orthorhombic, with space group Cmmm (No. 38). Its unit cell contains 36 atoms—Mg4 Cu12 Se16—distributed across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral Cu centers coordinated by four Se neighbors and octahedral Mg centers coordinated by six Se neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between tetrahedral Cu polyhedra and between tetrahedral Cu and octahedral Mg polyhedra, while Cu–Cu tetrahedra and Mg–Mg octahedra also show edge-sharing. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 36 sites.
